name: transcript-rail-icon-seats
description: transcript rail: the live thinking row's bulb, the content-free thinking row's Loader grid, and the notification head's status glyph all seat in one avatar column - above 700px every slot starts at the turn's left edge with its row's text at the content edge and a 10px speaker gap (the same seat ToolRow's kind icon occupies), and below it every slot leads its line inline with the text one full gutter later; no seat ever escapes the turn's box

mutation.declaration: loader.module.css: the @media (min-width: 700px) .rail { margin-left: calc(-1 * var(--speaker-gutter)) } gutter pull reverted to 0; separately verified, notificationcard.module.css's .statusIcon pull reverted to 0
mutation.note: Verified 2026-09-20, one pull at a time: each reverted pull fails the desktop leg's rail-origin assertion for its own row (slot.left lands 34px right of turn.left), naming the row - the Loader's .rail pull, notificationcard's .statusIcon pull, and the harness's reproduced think-row pull each re-run separately. Every row is caught by name, so the cross-row comparisons and the per-row origin arithmetic both carry the case.
